package main

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/jackc/pgx/v5/pgxpool"
	"github.com/vivym/vela/internal/workercontrol"
)

func main() {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	pool, err := pgxpool.New(ctx, os.Getenv("VELA_INTERNAL_DATABASE_URL"))
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	service, err := workercontrol.NewService(ctx, pool, workercontrol.Config{
		LeaseTTL:         2 * time.Minute,
		ActiveLeaseKeyID: "lease-key-v1",
		LeaseKeys: map[string][]byte{
			"lease-key-v1": []byte("0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef"),
		},
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	worker := workercontrol.AuthenticatedWorker{ID: uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_WORKER_ID"))}
	assignment, err := service.Acquire(ctx, worker, 7, &workercontrol.AssignmentCandidate{
		JobID:                      uuid.MustParse(os.Getenv("VELA_JOB_ID")),
		ExpectedJobVersion:         1,
		ExecutionProfileRevisionID: uuid.MustParse("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000014"),
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	credentials := workercontrol.LeaseCredentials{
		AttemptID:   assignment.AttemptID,
		WorkerEpoch: assignment.WorkerEpoch,
		Fence:       assignment.LeaseFence,
		Token:       assignment.LeaseToken,
	}
	started, err := service.Start(ctx, worker, credentials)
	if err != nil || started.Decision != workercontrol.StartGranted {
		fatal(fmt.Errorf("start N-1 failure probe = %#v error=%v", started, err))
	}
	decision, err := service.Fail(ctx, worker, credentials, workercontrol.FailureObservation{
		FailureClass:             "TRANSIENT_BACKEND",
		FailureFingerprint:       "sglang.process.exit.137",
		ErrorSummary:             "N-1 backend process exited before completing the Attempt",
		BackendStage:             "generation",
		GPUUUIDs:                 []string{"GPU-00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"},
		InferenceBackendRevision: "sglang-vela@e1c5054",
		RetryRecommended:         true,
		WorkerReusable:           true,
	})
	if err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
	if err := json.NewEncoder(os.Stdout).Encode(struct {
		Disposition string `json:"disposition"`
		AttemptID   string `json:"attempt_id"`
	}{
		Disposition: string(decision.Disposition),
		AttemptID:   decision.AttemptID.String(),
	}); err != nil {
		fatal(err)
	}
}

func fatal(err error) {
	_, _ = fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
	os.Exit(1)
}
